_comment: The view library: every angle, framing and head shot a full-character LoRA needs. `prompt` is natural language for the image model; `tags` is the caption the dataset prep writes for that view, so the two never drift apart. A character selects views by id (default: all). Each view also carries its own `background`, rotating through neutral fields so the background never correlates with the trigger (2026-09-21).

body.prompt: Full-body front view. She stands naturally and faces directly toward the camera, camera at eye level, arms relaxed at her sides, neutral posture, looking toward the viewer, feet fully visible.
body.tags: full body, standing, looking at viewer
body.background: a plain, even white background

body.prompt: Full-body three-quarter front view, her body rotated about 45 degrees from the camera, camera at eye level, relaxed standing pose, arms relaxed, looking toward the viewer, the front and the side construction of the outfit both clearly visible, feet fully visible.
body.tags: full body, standing, looking at viewer
body.background: a plain, even light grey background

body.prompt: Full-body exact side profile from her left side, camera perpendicular to her at eye level. She stands straight with arms relaxed and looks straight ahead in the direction her body faces. No accidental three-quarter rotation. Silhouette and side construction of the outfit clearly visible, feet fully visible.
body.tags: full body, standing, from side, profile
body.background: a plain, even warm sand-beige background
